subject: Aligning stakeholders + 30m demo — three slot options
content:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@orchardai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Aligning stakeholders + 30m demo — three slot options

Hi Priya —

Thanks again for the great conversation earlier. Quick recap / next steps from our side:

- Problem you described: bursty inference cost on peak batch jobs + inconsistent latency for multi-tenant pipelines.
- What we heard matters most: predictable tail latency for user-facing flows, clearer cost per-QPS reporting, and easier model rollouts across envs.
- Next step: 30-minute product intro + brief tech Q&A so we can show the latency/cost dashboard and a sketch of rollout policies.

To make scheduling simple, here are 3 options (all 30 minutes):

1) Tue Sep 15 — 10:00–10:30 AM PT (13:00–13:30 ET)
2) Wed Sep 16 — 9:00–9:30 AM PT (12:00–12:30 ET)
3) Thu Sep 17 — 11:30–12:00 PM PT (14:30–15:00 ET)

Proposed attendees: Priya (you), Sam Ortega (eng lead) — please confirm, plus:
- Jordan Blake — Account Exec (me)
- Marissa Cole — Solutions Engineer (product/feature walkthrough)
- Tessa Morgan — Technical PM (deployment/rollout questions)

Attached: mutual action plan (MAP) draft and an .ics with option 1 pre-filled. If none of these work, tell me two windows that do and I’ll slot. Also flag any stakeholders who must attend (security/compliance, infra).

Draft agenda (30m):
- 0–5m: quick intros + objectives
- 5–18m: product tour — latency dashboards, routing policies, cost controls
- 18–28m: brief technical Q&A / integration notes
- 28–30m: next steps / agree on technical deep dive scope

If helpful I can include a short list of expected data artifacts we’ll want to look at (sample traces, token distributions) so Marissa can prep.

Thanks — looking forward to locking in a time.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
(415) 555-0142

Attachment: orchardai-map-v1.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: proposed-demo-agenda.ics (text/calendar)

A few notes from my side:
- Sam (eng) is out Mon–Tue next week; he returns Wed morning.
- We need at least one person from infra/security for any discussion touching rollout and data isolation — I’ll check availability.
- Morning PT works best for our team.

Quick ask: could you also offer one later afternoon PT option (4pm-ish)? Our director sometimes can only make late slots.

I’ll coordinate internally and get back with firm attendees and which slot works.

Best,
Priya
